title: Connected Photographer
shortDescription: Event photographers scan a guest's badge and send the right shots straight to that guest's phone, so every visitor leaves with professional photos of themselves instead of searching a gallery of thousands.
longDescription: Connects the event photographer to the visitor journey. The photographer scans the QR code on a guest's badge, wristband, or ticket in the photographer app, picks the photos or short videos that show that guest, and sends them with one tap. The images appear in the guest's personal journey, where they can be viewed, downloaded, and shared, in the guest's own language. Several photographers can work in parallel across the venue, and scanning several badges sends a group shot to everyone in it. Branding, identifiers, delivery channels, and follow-up actions are configurable. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: No Searching Through Thousands of Photos
highlights.description: Guests don't scroll a public gallery or hunt for themselves in a cloud folder. Their photos are already waiting in their personal journey, matched to the badge they wear.

highlights.title: One Scan, One Tap
highlights.description: The photographer scans the guest's code, selects the shots, and sends them on the spot, so photos arrive during the event, while the moment is still fresh.

highlights.title: Professional Quality, Personal Moment
highlights.description: Unlike a selfie or a photobooth picture, the images come from a professional with proper light and composition, which makes guests feel looked after and makes the photos worth sharing.

highlights.title: Beyond the Snapshot
highlights.description: Add short video clips alongside the photos, a branded frame or sponsor mark on every image, printed copies at a pickup point, or a consent step so guests choose whether they want to be photographed.

highlights.title: Fits Every Occasion
highlights.description: Deliver portraits at a gala dinner, product moments at a trade fair stand, team shots at a corporate offsite, or meet-and-greet photos backstage at a festival.

highlights.title: See How Far the Photos Travel
highlights.description: Add a data layer that counts photos sent, opened, downloaded, and shared per guest and per photographer, so the client sees how far the event imagery reached.

highlights.title: Part of the Guest Journey
highlights.description: Pair with Visitor Identificator for the guest badges, with Journey Recap to send every photo in one summary after the event, with Photo Printing for printed copies, or with Shared Gallery for a public selection.
